title.vi: Hàm cửa sổ (3): tổng luỹ kế, trung bình trượt, LAG/LEAD
title.en: Window functions (3): running totals, moving averages, LAG/LEAD

summary.vi: ROWS BETWEEN, SUM() OVER luỹ kế, AVG trượt, LAG, tăng trưởng theo tháng
summary.en: ROWS BETWEEN, cumulative SUM() OVER, rolling AVG, LAG, month-over-month growth

files.name: query.sql
files.code:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', purchase_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue
  FROM purchases GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, revenue,
       SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)                                   AS running_total,
       ROUND(AVG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS ma3,
       LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)                                   AS prev_month
FROM m
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 6;

prompt.vi: Tính doanh thu theo THÁNG (month, revenue) cùng cột running_total là tổng luỹ kế theo thứ tự tháng. Chỉ lấy 5 tháng đầu, sắp xếp theo month.
prompt.en: Compute revenue per MONTH (month, revenue) with a running_total column, the cumulative sum in month order. Take only the first 5 months, sorted by month.

hint.vi: SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_total.
hint.en: SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_total.

starter.name: query.sql
starter.code: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', purchase_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM purchases GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 5;

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', purchase_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue
  FROM purchases GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, revenue,
       SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_total
FROM m
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 5;

prompt.vi: Tính tăng trưởng so với tháng trước theo phần trăm: cột month và growth_pct = ROUND((revenue - LAG)*100.0/LAG, 1) cho 6 tháng đầu có LAG (bỏ tháng đầu tiên). Sắp xếp theo month.
prompt.en: Compute growth versus the previous month as a percent: columns month and growth_pct = ROUND((revenue - LAG)*100.0/LAG, 1) for the first 6 months that have a LAG (skip the very first month). Sorted by month.

hint.vi: Tính LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) trong CTE rồi lọc prev IS NOT NULL.
hint.en: Compute LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) in a CTE then filter prev IS NOT NULL.

starter.name: query.sql
starter.code: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', purchase_date) AS month FROM purchases GROUP BY month LIMIT 6;

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', purchase_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue
  FROM purchases GROUP BY month
),
g AS (
  SELECT month, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev FROM m
)
SELECT month, ROUND((revenue - prev) * 100.0 / prev, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM g
WHERE prev IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 6;
